name: Modules.BLE.CentralManager
summary: An object that scans for, discovers, connects to, and manages peripherals.
description: CentralManager objects manage discovered or connected remote peripheral devices (represented by Peripheral objects), including scanning for, discovering, and connecting to advertising peripherals.

properties.name: isScanning
properties.summary: A Boolean value that indicates whether the central is currently scanning.

properties.name: peripherals
properties.summary: All discovered peripherals

properties.name: state
properties.summary: State of the module's internal central manager. For android, it is the current state of the local Bluetooth adapter. Its value is one of the MANAGER_STATE_* constants.

methods.name: cancelPeripheralConnection
methods.summary: Cancels an active or pending connection to peripheral. Note that this is non-blocking, and any Peripheral commands that are still pending to peripheral may or may not complete.

parameters.name: peripheral
parameters.summary: peripheral object which connnection will be canceled

methods.name: connectPeripheral
methods.summary: Initiates a connection to peripheral. Connection attempts never time out and, depending on the outcome, will result in a call to either didConnectPeripheral or didFailToConnectPeripheral event. Pending attempts are cancelled automatically upon deallocation of peripheral, and explicitly via Modules.BLE.CentralManager.cancelPeripheralConnection}.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: This parameter is specific for the iphone, ipad platforms. An optional dictionary specifying connection behavior options. all available dictionary keys are defined as Modules.BLE.CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_*

methods.name: createPeripheral
methods.summary: Creates a Modules.BLE.Peripheral class object with the given address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.summary: address of the remote bluetooth device.

methods.name: isAccessFineLocationPermissionGranted
methods.summary: Determines whether the ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission is granted or not.
methods.description:
ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission is provided at runtime by the app user. To request this permission
use [requestAccessFineLocationPermission](api:Modules.BLE.CentralManager#requestAccessFineLocationPermission) method

returns.summary: Returns true if the ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission is granted

methods.name: registerForConnectionEvents
methods.summary: Calls connectionEventDidOccur event when a connection event occurs matching any of the given options. Passing nil in the option parameter clears any prior registered matching options.

methods.name: requestAccessFineLocationPermission
methods.description: This permission is necessary for the Bluetooth device to scan the nearby BLE devices or other Bluetooth operations.

methods.name: retrieveConnectedPeripheralsWithServices
methods.summary: Returns a list of the peripherals connected to the system whose services match a given set of criteria.

methods.name: retrievePeripheralsWithIdentifiers
methods.summary: Returns a list of known peripherals by their identifiers.

parameters.name: UUIDs
parameters.summary: A list of peripheral identifiers from which Peripheral objects can be retrieved.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary: Key/value pairs specifying options for the scan.

properties.name: allowDuplicatesKey
properties.summary: A Boolean value that specifies whether the scan should run without duplicate filtering.

properties.name: solicitedServiceUUIDsKey
properties.summary: An array of service UUIDs that you want to scan for.

events.name: connectionEventDidOccur
events.summary: This method is called upon the connection or disconnection of a peripheral that matches any of the options provided in registerForConnectionEventsWithOptions

properties.name: event
properties.summary: event value will be Moduels.BLE.CONNECTION_EVENT_TYPE_PEER_DISCONNECTED or Moduels.BLE.CONNECTION_EVENT_TYPE_PEER_CONNECTED

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: object of peripheral.

events.name: didConnectPeripheral
events.summary: This event is called when a connection initiated by connectPeripheral has succeeded.
events.description: This event is called when a connection initiated by connectPeripheral has succeeded.

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: An object representing the peripheral that connected to the local central manager.

events.name: didDisconnectPeripheral
events.summary: This event is called when a peripheral disconnected.
events.description:
This event is called upon the disconnection of a peripheral that was connected by connectPeripheral If the disconnection
was not initiated by cancelPeripheralConnection, the cause will be detailed in the error parameter. Once this method has been
called, no more event will be invoked on peripheral.

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: An object representing the peripheral that disconnected.

properties.name: errorCode
properties.summary: The error code; only present if an error occurred.

properties.name: errorDomain
properties.summary: The error domain; only present if an error occurred..

events.name: didDiscoverPeripheral
events.summary: A event called when centrel manager discover peripheral
events.description:
This method is invoked while scanning, upon the discovery of peripheral by central. A discovered peripheral must
be retained in order to use it; otherwise, it is assumed to not be of interest and will be cleaned up by the central manager. For
a list of discovered peripherals, see peripherals property

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: object of discovered  peripheral

events.name: didFailToConnectPeripheral
events.summary: This event is called when a connection initiated by connectPeripheral has failed.
events.description:
This event is called when a connection initiated by connectPeripheral has failed to complete. As connection attempts do not
timeout, the failure of a connection is atypical and usually indicative of a transient issue.

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: An object representing the peripheral that failed to connect.

properties.name: errorCode
properties.summary: The error code; only present if an error occurred.

properties.name: errorDomain
properties.summary: The error domain; only present if an error occurred..

events.name: didUpdateANCSAuthorization
events.summary: This event is called when the authorization status changes for a peripheral connected with connectPeripheral with option Modules.BLE.CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_REQUIRES_ANCS

properties.name: peripheral
properties.summary: object of peripheral which disconnected.

events.name: didUpdateState
events.summary: A event called when centrel manager state updated
events.description:
Invoked whenever the central manager's state has been updated. Commands should only be issued when the state is
Modules.BLE.MANAGER_STATE_POWERED_ON. A state below Modules.BLE.MANAGER_STATE_POWERED_ON
implies that scanning has stopped and any connected peripherals have been disconnected. If the state moves below
Modules.BLE.MANAGER_STATE_POWERED_OFF, all Peripheral objects obtained from this central
manager become invalid and must be retrieved or discovered again.

properties.name: state
properties.summary: state of central manager

events.name: willRestoreState
events.summary: A event called when centrel manager will restore state
events.description:
For apps that opt-in to state preservation and restoration, this is the first event invoked when your app is relaunched into 
the background to complete some Bluetooth-related task. Use this method to synchronize your app's state with the state of the
Bluetooth system.

properties.name: peripherals
properties.summary: The array contains all of the peripherals connected to the central manager (or had a pending connection) at the time the system terminated the app.

properties.name: services
properties.summary: an NSArray of service UUIDs containing all the services the central manager was scanning for at the time the system terminated the app.

properties.name: options
properties.summary: The dictionary contains all of the peripheral scan options in use by the central manager when the system terminated the app.
